projects.title: TAQEN Collection
projects.summary: A team of six built a print-on-demand clothing brand. It never got an order and is no longer developed. The case study covers what was built and what went wrong.
projects.outcome: No orders. The store is still online, but no longer developed.
projects.shows: A working storefront with a home page, product catalog, cart and information pages, backed by a database for products and orders. Ruhan Tahlil designed the website and created the initial designs. The case study also lists what went wrong and what the team learned.

projects.title: Classly
projects.summary: Demo admin software for a language center: student registration, class tracking and course pricing. It runs in your browser and saves sample data on your own device. Designed with Barshon, who is not part of Curiohatch.
projects.builtBy: Ruhan Tahlil and Barshon. Design and systems design by Barshon.
projects.outcome: A demo for an agency. It did not lead to a sale.
projects.shows: A multi-screen app you can use yourself: a three-step registration form that works out fees, a class counter, a course and pricing list, staff accounts and an analytics overview. It is a demo with no server and no real sign-in.

projects.title: Landing page template
projects.summary: A one-page layout for a local business, filled with sample text and placeholder details. Open it to see how a template-based site would look.
